content: {"episode_id":"ep-05209","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) based on recurrent episodes of syncope and transient cerebral ischemic attacks, which raise concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
